title.narrative: HCFC Phase-out Management Plan in Room Air-conditioner Sector in China # Stage I

description.narrative: HCFC Phase-out Management Plan in Room Air-conditioner Sector in China # Phase I To convert air-conditioner manufacturers to ensure that China can reach compliance with the Montreal Protocol#s control measures in 2013 and 2015. The HPMP define the basis and guidelines for the activities to be implemented in the RAC sector to achieve the phase-out targets set for the Phase I (2011-2015). China decided to introduce R290 as the major technology in phasing out HCFC-22 during the implementation of HPMP in RAC sector. The implementation of this project would convert existing production lines using R22. To meet the targets set for the Phase I of the HPMP, a total of 35 RAC production lines have to be converted. Of those, 18 RAC production lines will be converted to R290 technology using MLF funds.
